## Highlights

- Added complete Text-to-Speech workflows for speaking selected text, converting individual text files, and creating audiobooks from whole folders.
- Added resumable long-form TTS conversion: pause safely, continue after an app/network interruption, and export the completed portion without repeating finished provider requests.
- Added built-in voice presets and first-run guidance for cloud, local, and Windows speech providers.
- Cloud TTS audio now begins playing as it arrives, with clearer error overlays and an always-visible close button.
- Improved file transcription cancellation, subtitle timing, language handling, audio decoding, and protection against accidental output overwrites.
- Hardened model and local TTS downloads against cancellation, interrupted installs, corrupt files, and failed model switches.
- Added beginner-friendly in-app Help and safer shortcut, live-sound, microphone, and settings behavior.

---

**Notice:**
If the application crashes on an older CPU during transcription, use the Microsoft Store build when a matching Store release is available for this version.
